name: Follow the Curiosity
thesis: A midnight observatory connects Raygen’s love of making with the real people and characters at the heart of Hack Club.
interaction: Stardance’s character trio settles into a bounded opening motion; a fine orbital path connects working navigation to Hack Club, machines, and Raygen.
why: Authentic Stardance art becomes the visual protagonist, with warm expressive serif type and personal connections taking precedence over a conventional engineering portfolio.
